messages:
ops_anya: Vendor just raised HS-code hold in FRA. Proposed split: rush 7 H100 by air, remainder by sea. Need quick call on air surcharge and who takes insurance.

vendor_michael: Correct — customs flagged cooler assembly wording. Air for 7 available at +$1.25k/unit incl. fast-track clearance. Sea is standard but +9 days. Insurance: vendor asks 50/50; we can offer 30/70 if you prepay duties.

infra_tom: eu-west pool has 4 degraded nodes and 2 offline racks. If 7 arrive early we should route them to racks r3/r4 first (latency-critical). Depot cross-dock can accept 9 crates Tue morning. Need original serials on AWB, not temp IDs.

finance_raj: Quick budget check: +8.75k surcharge total. We can approve as emergency charge if ops tag OPS-4992. Prefer vendor 30/70 insurance but require photo-evidence clause for DOA claims.

sre_kevin: Also confirm crate foam spec and shock log. Last sea shipment had no shock log and depot rejected one DOA claim. We need 7-day RMA booking SLA for air DOAs and 14-day for sea.

logistics-bot: Manifest preview: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/FR-7777 1 AWB preview FR7777-01.

ops_anya: vendor_michael 1 can you confirm AWB will include original serials, preprinted RMA labels, photo checklist, and shock log for H100 crates? We need docs in thread before PO amend.

vendor_michael: Will include original serials and shock log. Preprinted RMA labels + photo checklist included. We can prepay duties for air at +$500 flat if that helps. Will set insurance 35/65 (vendor/redwood) if you accept duty prepay.

infra_tom: 35/65 acceptable if we get shock log and serials. Ops: schedule cordon/drain windows for r3/r4; do a 2-node canary first.

finance_raj: OK approving emergency spend with OPS-4992 tag. I'll prepare PO amend; need vendor invoice line for duty prepay.

ops_anya: Opening ops ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4992. Scheduling maintenance windows: canary Wed 01:00-02:00 UTC, bulk Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC.

vendor_michael: Ack 1 updating manifest FR-7777 with AWB FR7777-01 and will post customs clearance receipt + packing list here by EOD. Reply with "ack" when PO amend + AWB live.
